bailout.name: Poor Man's Bailout
bailout.definition: Days for the selected money stock to grow by one bitcoin market cap. On a date t, with window start s and N calendar days between them, d(t) = C(t) / g(t) when the average growth per day g(t) is positive. C is the bitcoin market cap in dollars.

methods.regression: OLS slope of the daily forward-filled level from s through t, dollars per day
methods.cagr: M(t) × ((M(t) / M(s))^(1/N) − 1), the compound pace at today's level

bailout.alignment: Each money series is stepped forward to every calendar day: the last print stays in effect until the next one. The bitcoin market cap is the print on that calendar day, or the latest print on or before it. The series is evaluated through the later of the two last prints, so the older one is carried forward. Monthly Board dates are restamped to the first of the month when the snapshot comes from H.6, matching FRED.
bailout.contraction: If g(t) is zero or negative the day count is undefined. It is not plotted, and it is never stored as a negative or infinite number.

btc.name: Bitcoin market cap
btc.retrieval: Coin Metrics community API, no key. Metrics CapMrktCurUSD (market cap, USD) and PriceUSD, daily.

measures.name: US M2
measures.retrieval: FRED CSV for M2SL. Billions of dollars, seasonally adjusted, monthly, converted to dollars × 1e9. Weekly not-seasonally-adjusted M2 (FRED WM2NS) is not spliced on, because mixing it with seasonally adjusted M2 would add a seasonal jump.

measures.name: Monetary base
measures.retrieval: FRED CSV for BOGMBASE. Billions of dollars, not seasonally adjusted, monthly, converted to dollars × 1e9. Full history of the series.

measures.name: Currency in circulation
measures.retrieval: FRED CSV for MBCURRCIR. Billions of dollars, not seasonally adjusted, monthly, converted to dollars × 1e9. This is FRED MBCURRCIR (monetary base; currency in circulation), not the older CURRCIR series. Full history of MBCURRCIR.

measures.name: Public debt
measures.frequency: daily, with earlier history spliced in front
measures.published_units: Dollars (Debt to the Penny). Earlier history converted to dollars.
measures.retrieval: Treasury Fiscal Data Debt to the Penny, field tot_pub_debt_out_amt, daily from 1993-04-01, already in dollars. History before the daily file is FRED GFDEBTN (Federal Debt: Total Public Debt), millions of dollars, quarterly, converted to dollars × 1e6.

measures.name: Fed balance sheet
measures.retrieval: FRED CSV for WALCL. Millions of dollars, Wednesday level, not seasonally adjusted, converted to dollars × 1e6. Total assets less eliminations from consolidation.
